Daily refresh 2026-10-21 (SHORT Wednesday)

Daily SummaryCautious

Cautious — ETF buyers came back in size, but only through one door, and spot demand underneath is still thin.

  • 🟡Wednesday lensMonday's BTC ETF print was about +$527M (Farside), the best day in roughly a month, with IBIT taking ~$665M while Fidelity and Grayscale bled. BTC climbed back toward $83k on Tuesday as oil and yields cooled on an Iran-deal report that was later denied. Under the surface the Coinbase premium is at its most negative since early July and stablecoin supply is shrinking, so the bid is not broad. Futures are back in Leveraged Sell-Off (7d OI +2.5%, px −0.2%, CoC 10-20) with funding ~+9%. Thursday's weekly Fed print carries Treasury-cash risk. ~$80k below and ~$84k above still frame the week.
  • 🟡BTC is bouncing+1.3% this week, -4.6% over the month.
  • 🟢Why it mattersmoney flows are supportive — Fed liquidity ↑ improving (Wed 10-14 print), Treasury cash rebuilding, ETFs +$364M last week.

Outlook probabilities

Base case is a range ($80–86k) at 55%; downside slightly more likely than upside (30% vs 15%). Held 7D 55/15/30 and 1M 50/10/40. The ETF inflow day and a positive WoW tape argue against more downside, but the demand came through a single fund, the Coinbase premium is deeply negative, stablecoins are shrinking and leverage keeps outrunning price, so Bull isn't raised. Thursday's Fed print (Treasury cash rebuild) and the Oct 27–28 FOMC are the next tests.
